question: Which of the following is used as an antacid to neutralize stomach acidity?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Magnesium Hydroxide.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Magnesium hydroxide** is used as an **antacid to neutralize stomach acidity** by reacting with **hydrochloric acid **in the stomach to form **magnesium chloride and water.**
 
• It is also known as** milk of magnesia **and is available in the form of** suspension or chewable tablets.**
 
• **Iodoform** is an **antiseptic** and is used to **treat wounds and prevent infections. **
 
• **Morphine** is a **painkiller **and is used to **relieve severe pain.**
 
• **Chlorine** is a **chemical element** and is used for various purposes such as **water treatment, disinfection, and bleaching.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Magnesium hydroxide** is also used as a **laxative to relieve constipation.**
 
• **Iodoform **is a **yellow crystalline substance **with a characteristic odor.
 
 
• It is a** halogenated derivative of methane** and contains iodine atoms.
 
 
 
• **Morphine **is derived from** opium** and is a** highly addictive substance.**
 
 
• It is a **controlled substance** and is used for** medicinal purposes **under strict regulations. 
 
 
 
• **Chlorine **is a **greenish-yellow gas** with a pungent odor.
 
 
• It is highly reactive and is used for various** industrial and household purposes.**
 
• It is also used in the production of **PVC and other chemicals.**
